snippet.title: THE LIGHT OF SUMMER | Full Game Playthrough | A Heartwarming Horror Game | Free PC Game
snippet.description:
The Light of Summer is an RPG-maker game about a grandfather who desires to be a guardian spirit to protect his family especially his granddaughter. In order to become one, he has to pass a certain exam. Will he be able to hit the mark?

SP: It really is a wonderful, and heartwarming game! I truly enjoyed it except for the fact that on my first tries, the examiner is nowhere when I opened one of the doors.

The ending made me emotional. :')

***********

Developed By: Mareffy
